meta.name: Presumed Innocent
meta.description: A horrific murder upends the Chicago Prosecuting Attorney's Office when one of its own is suspected of the crime—leaving the accused fighting to keep his family together.

videos.title: Bases Loaded
videos.overview: Chief deputy prosecutor Rusty Sabich is determined to investigate the horrific murder of his colleague Carolyn Polhemus.

videos.title: People vs. Rozat Sabich
videos.overview: Tommy Molto continues to build his case as Raymond comes to Rusty's defense.

videos.title: Discovery
videos.overview: Rusty learns of the evidence against him. Barbara looks to protect herself and her family as new secrets emerge.

videos.title: The Burden
videos.overview: Kyle is confronted about his whereabouts the night of the murder. Tommy questions Carolyn's son when the case takes a complicated turn.

videos.title: Pregame
videos.overview: Raymond insists Rusty is innocent, but the weight of the looming trial pushes the Sabich family to its breaking point.

videos.title: The Elements
videos.overview: The trial begins. Startling events inside the courtroom threaten to derail proceedings.

videos.title: The Witness
videos.overview: Rusty is forced to pivot his legal strategy. Tommy receives a disturbing message.

videos.title: The Verdict
videos.overview: The truth behind Carolyn's murder is revealed.

meta.slogan: New season. New case. New lies.
